game_settings_mode_difficulty_check.name: game_settings_mode_difficulty_check
game_settings_mode_difficulty_check.value:
(
        ("game_settings"."game_mode" = 'solo' AND "game_settings"."ai_difficulty" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("game_settings"."game_mode" = 'multiplayer' AND "game_settings"."ai_difficulty" IS NULL)
      )

magic_rule_compilations_state_check.name: magic_rule_compilations_state_check
magic_rule_compilations_state_check.value:
(
        ("magic_rule_compilations"."status" = 'ready' AND "magic_rule_compilations"."rules_json" IS NOT NULL
          AND "magic_rule_compilations"."world_code" IS NOT NULL
          AND "magic_rule_compilations"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "magic_rule_compilations"."lease_until" IS NULL) OR
        ("magic_rule_compilations"."status" = 'compiled' AND "magic_rule_compilations"."rules_json" IS NOT NULL
          AND "magic_rule_compilations"."world_code" IS NULL
          AND "magic_rule_compilations"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "magic_rule_compilations"."lease_until" IS NULL) OR
        ("magic_rule_compilations"."status" = 'pending' AND "magic_rule_compilations"."rules_json" IS NULL
          AND "magic_rule_compilations"."world_code" IS NULL
          AND "magic_rule_compilations"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "magic_rule_compilations"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
      )

push_account_deliveries_kind_check.name: push_account_deliveries_kind_check
push_account_deliveries_kind_check.value: ("push_account_deliveries"."kind" = 'friend_request' AND "push_account_deliveries"."friend_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "push_account_deliveries"."game_id" IS NULL) OR ("push_account_deliveries"."kind" = 'challenge' AND "push_account_deliveries"."game_id" IS NOT NULL AND "push_account_deliveries"."friend_request_id" IS NULL)

referral_attributions_credits_check.name: referral_attributions_credits_check
referral_attributions_credits_check.value:
(
        ("referral_attributions"."status" = 'pending' AND "referral_attributions"."credits" = 0 AND "referral_attributions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR
        ("referral_attributions"."status" = 'rewarded' AND "referral_attributions"."credits" > 0 AND "referral_attributions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )
